news.title: Forecasting space weather risks on power grids
news.summary_raw:
Extreme space-weather events can damage power systems on Earth and degrade GPS accuracy and satellite operations. A new machine learning system can predict where damage is likely to occur 30-60 minutes before a storm arrives.
The post Forecasting space weather risks on power grids appeared first on Microsoft Research.
news.summary: Microsoft Research has released a machine‑learning model that forecasts space‑weather events capable of damaging power grids 30–60 minutes in advance. The system uses satellite telemetry and climate data to pinpoint vulnerable infrastructure ahead of storms.
news.enterprise_use: Monitor the Microsoft Research blog for updates on the model’s API or SDK availability. Consider integrating its alerts with your MDM or SSO logs to pre‑emptively adjust device connectivity during predicted geomagnetic disturbances.

news.title: Introducing Quine: An AI research system designed for the complexity of biology
news.summary_raw:
Biology doesn't operate in silos, and neither should the AI representation of it. Quine is an early-stage research effort to create a multimodal world model of biology. By connecting insights across biological scales and modalities, Quine helps scientists computationally search a space far larger than intuition allows and prioritize hypotheses before they reach the lab. Experimental results provide important feedback, helping researchers sharpen future research directions.
The post Introducing Q
news.summary: Microsoft Research has unveiled Quine, an early-stage AI research system that builds a multimodal world model of biology. The platform integrates data across biological scales to enable computational hypothesis generation and prioritization.
news.enterprise_use: Check your internal documentation to see if any of your current bioinformatics or data analytics projects could benefit from a multimodal AI model. While Quine is not a commercial tool, staying aware of its capabilities may inform future investment in AI-driven research analytics that could integrate with your existing data infrastructure.
